segmente.text: These are the three questions every customer asks himself before they buy something from you.
They always ask, what is this, will it help me, and can I trust it?
If you answer these questions fast and understandable, you are already ahead of 90% of marketers.
Because people don't decide when they are unsure.
They decide when they feel understood and safe about their choice.
So make them understand exactly what they will be getting.
